title: upgrade-journal
description: The updater's record of one upgrade, in the broker's folder (writable only by SYSTEM and administrators; the network service may read it). The updater writes it before each step, so an upgrade cut short by a restart is finished or undone when the broker starts again, and the network service reports the outcome to the server once it is final. Phases: verified (every check passed), stopping, backing_up, installing, waiting (for the new version to check in), then succeeded, rolled_back or failed.

checkInBy.description: When waiting: the new version must have checked in by this time, or the backup is restored.
